first_party_role_observation: HPRA states that it grants licences to make distribute and market medicines after safety quality and effectiveness review
notes: Self-reported scope; no sampled product decision or consolidated statute

first_party_role_observation: HPRA describes inspections of health-product companies and facilities and ongoing medicine safety and quality monitoring
notes: Oversight is distinct from each individual medicine marketing authorisation

first_party_role_observation: AIFA states a medicinal product marketed in Italy requires a marketing authorisation issued by AIFA or the European Commission
notes: Competence depends on national or centralised route; an EMA scientific opinion is not itself the grant

first_party_role_observation: AIFA states it defines reimbursement and supply classifications and negotiates medicine prices charged to the national health service
notes: Italy-specific price and reimbursement role is not an EMA-wide price setting power

first_party_role_observation: SUKL describes itself as Czech Republic administrative body and national competent authority for human medicines reporting to the Ministry of Health
notes: Source cites Act No 79/1997 Coll but original statute and amendments have not been independently reviewed

first_party_role_observation: SUKL reports maximum medicine price and public insurance reimbursement decision responsibilities effective from 1 January 2008
notes: Historical start comes from regulator webpage citing Act No 48/1997 Coll; current consolidated law not audited

first_party_role_observation: NOMA states that its marketing authorisation is required for placing medicine on the Norwegian market and describes EEA rules as implemented via national legislation
notes: May 2026 is webpage update date not legal effective date; individual EEA instruments and exceptions unaudited

first_party_role_observation: NOMA describes regulating prescription medicine prices and deciding eligibility for general reimbursement in Norway
notes: Reported national health economics remit differs from EMA authorisation; individual patient reimbursement may involve another body

first_party_role_observation: NOMA describes human medicine quality safety and efficacy reviews and approval of Norwegian product characteristics leaflets and labelling
notes: Authority role not an approval of any particular product or clinical guideline
